description: Regression tasks for meept dispatch/routing bugs. Pins gap-9 routing (create-a-file routed to chat, fixed 4f48e129), planner tool_hint=coder fall-through to chat (fixed a0939721), and direct-to-disk writes (staged writes never reach disk). No benchmark content, safe to commit and publish.

tasks.prompt: Create a file named routing-check.txt in the repository root containing the text: dispatch works. Use file_write with direct:true.
Create a file named hint-check.txt in the repository root containing the text: hint ok. Use file_write with direct:true.
Create a file named direct-check.txt in the repository root containing: written directly. Use file_write with direct:true.
